Select the first 200 metabolism records for the enzyme UGT1A9. Join metabolism to compound_records on substrate_record_id to get the substrate compound, then join to molecule_dictionary for substrate names and to compound_structures for canonical_smiles (inner join). Optionally join molecule_hierarchy from the substrate molregno to retrieve parent compound names. Return canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, and enzyme_name. Do not add sorting; preserve source row order.
